description: Provision an AWS S3files AccessPoint via the ACK s3files controller. Fields mirror the s3files.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 AccessPoint spec.

fileSystemID.description:
The ID or Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the S3 File System.

Regex Pattern: `^(arn:aws[-a-z]*:s3files:[0-9a-z-:]+:file-system/fs-[0-9a-f]{17,40}|fs-[0-9a-f]{17,40})$`

fileSystemRef.description:
AWSResourceReferenceWrapper provides a wrapper around *AWSResourceReference
type to provide more user friendly syntax for references using 'from' field
Ex:
APIIDRef:

	from:
	  name: my-api

from.description:
AWSResourceReference provides all the values necessary to reference another
k8s resource for finding the identifier(Id/ARN/Name)

posixUser.description:
The POSIX identity with uid, gid, and secondary group IDs for user enforcement
when accessing the file system through this access point.

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

rootDirectory.description:
The root directory path for the access point, with optional creation permissions
for newly created directories.

creationPermissions.description:
Specifies the permissions to set on newly created directories within the
file system.

tags.description: An array of key-value pairs to apply to the access point for resource tagging.

items.description: A key-value pair for resource tagging.

title: AWS S3files AccessPoint
